description: Look up what Lowdown has recorded about an agent, tool, or service. Returns recorded interactions (count, outcomes, success rate). The success rate counts organic tool calls and agent reports only; protocol requests, rejected requests, and seeded or synthetic records are counted separately. For MCP Registry servers it also returns a separate `scanner` block: daily Lowdown Scanner observations of initialize and tools/list reachability, HTTP status, tool count, and tool-schema changes over the last 30 days. Scanner data is observation, not a score. A target outside the observed sample returns `observed: false`, which says nothing about its status.

target.description: MCP Registry name with the mcp: prefix (e.g. 'mcp:io.github.user/server'), a short name, or an id such as 'agent:some-agent-id'

name: get_lowdown
